EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Alchemical Resistance
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: +1 Fortitude save. Each core ability you take in this tree beyond the first grants +5 Fire, Cold, Acid, Electric, and poison Spell Power, as well as +1 Burning Ambition Dice.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Requires New Name
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: Passive: +4 Intelligence, +2 Conjuration DCs. While in Pyrite Reaction, you gain +2% Fire, Cold, Electric, Acid, and Poison Spell Critical Damage.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Spellvial Selection I
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: Select an Element to specialize in.

EnhancementSelection.Name: SLA: Venom Vial
EnhancementSelection.Description:
SLA: Vial of Venom Metamagic: Empower, Maximize, Quicken, Heighten, Enlarge, Eschew Materials Spell Point Cost: 1 Cooldown 4 seconds Primer Element: Crimsonite
Conjuring a bottle of magical poison, you throw a projectile at a single foe that deals 3 to 8 Poison damage per caster level, max caster level 10. This poison will leave the enemy Contaminated.
DND Dice: Deals 1d6+2 Poison damage per caster level, max 10d6+20

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Burning Ambition
EnhancementTreeItem.Description:
When your Reaction is Pyrite, your offensive Crimsonite and Gildleaf Alchemist spells will ignite your enemies with magic, dealing additional damage. This damage determines its element based on the element of the spell cast. Different elements can be ignited at the same time.
This ability begins at 1d4 damage, adding another 1d4 for each Burning Ambition die you get from other abilities. This damage scales with Spell Power.

EnhancementTreeItem.Name: Bombardier: Augmentation
EnhancementTreeItem.Description: +2 Caster Levels with Crimsonite and Gildleaf spells.
